annotations.rationale: Nine users on virtual desktops share one history: their profile disks were restored from backup. The customer already says the browser works, and the engineer rules out a shared site before looking at the logs, which hold nothing for the failing attempts. A targeted reset of the Teams data and the account broker data in one profile fixes it, then the other eight. Here a cache reset is the right first remedy, so it is an action without a fork, and the fix is reported by the customer. Only the signals that the text states are labelled; the browser works and the nine are not in one place, which are denials.
